clauses.quote: The specific dates for Open House, Back-to-School Night, and parent conferences shall be determined by the District.
clauses.subject_text: The specific dates for Open House, Back-to-School Night, and parent conferences
clauses.notes: Subject is dates, but duty falls on District.

clauses.quote: Alterations to these dates may be made by sites with mutual agreement between administration and a majority of site-assigned unit members.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; sites/administration have discretion subject to mutual agreement.

clauses.quote: The site administration shall notify the District in writing no less than 20 duty days prior to the changes.
The District shall, on a timely basis, forward a copy of all changes to the Association.
Prorated sick leave shall be provided for those unit members working beyond a regular contract as follows:
clauses.notes: Introduces benefit table; creates right to prorated sick leave for extended contracts.

clauses.quote: Each unit member shall have at least a 30 minute duty-free, uninter-rupted lunch period exclusive of passing periods.
The instructional day for unit members shall conform with the required minutes provided in Education Code, Section 46201.
clauses.subject_text: The instructional day for unit members
clauses.notes: Subject is 'instructional day', but duty falls on management to schedule accordingly.
